name: ai-health-copilot
description: Health AI advisor that matches your task — sedentary posture alerts, meal logging, chat-based health records or building a medical agent — to one of five open-source projects, then checks deployment and model requirements before you commit.

displayDescription.en: Matches your task to one of five open-source health projects, checks deployment and model requirements, and hands you a setup list you can actually run.
displayDescription.zh: 按久坐提醒、饮食记录、聊天录入等场景，从五个开源项目挑能落地的一套，核对部署与模型要求再上手。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我天天坐 10 小时写代码，想让 AI 帮我管坐姿和饮食，该用哪套？
defaultInitPrompt.en: I sit coding 10 hours a day — which stack should I use to have AI watch my posture and diet?

quickPrompts.en: I sit coding 10 hours a day — which stack should I use to have AI watch my posture and diet?
quickPrompts.zh: 我天天坐 10 小时写代码，想让 AI 帮我管坐姿和饮食，该用哪套？

quickPrompts.en: I want to log weight, sleep and meals by chat every day — pick a stack and get it running
quickPrompts.zh: 我想把每天的体重、睡眠、饮食用聊天记下来，帮我选工具并跑起来

quickPrompts.en: How do these health projects deploy, and which models or API keys do they need?
quickPrompts.zh: 这几个健康项目分别怎么部署，需要什么模型和 API key？
